about: Owner labels on real critic findings. Ground truth for per-critic precision (evals/calibrate.py report). Format and routine: taste/calibration.md. The two entries below are examples, marked example: true, and are ignored by the report.
label_line: <slug>/c<cycle>-<critic NN>-<k> valid | invalid[: note] | sev <1|2|3>[: note]

entry_fields.id: <slug>/c<cycle>-<critic NN>-<k>; k is the 1-based position in history/cycle-<cycle>/critic-<NN>.json findings
entry_fields.severity: severity the critic gave (1-3), null when the finding file was not found
entry_fields.label: valid | invalid | wrong-severity
entry_fields.correct_severity: the owner's severity when label is wrong-severity, else null
entry_fields.rubric: short git hash of the critic's rubric file when labelled
entry_fields.model: model that ran the critics, when known
entry_fields.example: true only for the starter examples

entries.issue: EXAMPLE: the try segment has a 30-second timer on a judgement question.
entries.label: valid
entries.note: EXAMPLE entry, not a real label

entries.issue: EXAMPLE: the explanation sentence runs 18 어절.
entries.label: wrong-severity
entries.note: EXAMPLE entry, not a real label: a long sentence is polish here, not a blocker
